newsitem.title: USA: Grand River Oklahoma coal unit seen on line Sat.
newsitem.headline: Grand River Oklahoma coal unit seen on line Sat.

text.p: Grand River Dam Authority said Wednesday its 490 megawatt (MW) coal-fired unit is expected to return to service Saturday after tripping off line earlier today.
"Unit 1 was taken off line due to a tube pressure leak. It should be back Saturday," a company spokeswoman said.
The adjacent unit 2, with a generating capacity of 520 MW, was also off line for scheduled maintenance, she said. However, a restart date for this unit was not available.
Both units are located at the GRDA Coal Fired Complex in Chouteau, Ok.
